recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Create a browser-native mobile dress-up game titled **Dali Surreal Couture Atelier**. Preserve a paper-doll customizer loop with four category tabs, a grid of selectable items, instant central avatar preview, a percentage completion meter, feedback on selection, and a camera/gallery modal that returns to editing. Reinterpret the game as a Salvador Dali-inspired surreal couture studio: the avatar is a surreal muse with curled moustache options, impossible jackets, melting hems, and relic accessories such as soft clocks, eggs, canes, and ants. Use a procedural animated canvas background with dream desert bands, melting clocks, museum-gold light, and biomorphic lines. Keep all UI mobile-readable and all buttons native-tappable.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
- genre: Paper-doll dress-up customization game.
- objective: Select category items to instantly preview a complete styled avatar, then open a snapshot/portrait modal.
- input model: Mobile-safe tap/click on tabs, item cards, camera CTA, and return CTA.
- core loop: Choose category -> choose item -> preview updates immediately -> meter/feedback update -> optionally take snapshot -> return and restyle.
- fail/friction state: No loss state; only non-selected categories or accessory none reduce completion percentage.

## Protected Mechanics
- Four customization lanes remain selectable through tabs.
- Item selection updates the central avatar immediately.
- Completion meter is derived from selected clothing/accessory state.
- Camera/gallery CTA hides editor and shows a modal celebration state.
- Return CTA restores the editor without resetting the look.
- Continuous canvas loop preserves live preview, breathing/bounce motion, and particles.

## Safe Theming Surfaces
HUD vocabulary, item names, colors, procedural character forms, particles, background, category labels, feedback copy, audio choices, and snapshot copy are presentation-only and safe to transform.
